evaluation_mode: source-backed dataset selection and preregistration draft

decision.development_dataset: Carter et al. 2024 via AddBiomechanics Core
decision.internal_load_stress_test: Grand Challenge Competition to Predict In Vivo Knee Loads
decision.first_quantity_of_interest: force-plate-measured 3D ground reaction force normalized by body weight and contact state
decision.canonical_representation: NumPy arrays plus coordinate, unit, frame, processing, missingness and provenance metadata
decision.b3d_role: source adapter format, not a Human Model dependency

sources.role_limit: kinematic and shape coverage; not force validation
diagnostic only; insufficient participant count for generalization

participant_manifest.split_rule: within each source sex label, sort by age ascending then participant ID; zero-based index modulo 5: 0=test, 3=validation, otherwise development

leakage_rules: exclude dynamics-pass features that were optimized against force-plate data
exclude validation and test participants from normalization, fitting, feature selection and threshold selection
exclude the OpenCap/Uhlrich raw source from development when used as external validation
do not count reprocessing of the same raw source as independent validation
aggregate primary evaluation by participant, not by frame
not_executed: Carter B3D or raw participant archive download
